Ericsson is looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner – Early Careers (Intern & Co-op), based in Ottawa, to support intern and co-op hiring across Canada and the United States. This role is central to delivering high-quality early talent hiring outcomes through close collaboration with hiring managers, universities, and internal stakeholders.

The successful candidate will manage end-to-end recruitment for intern and co-op positions, ensuring a seamless experience for both candidates and hiring managers while maintaining compliance with Canadian and US hiring requirements. This is a full-time, experienced-level position based in Ottawa.

Manage full-cycle recruitment for intern and co-op roles across Canada and the US
Collaborate with hiring managers to define hiring needs, timelines, selection criteria, and structured interview plans
Lead intake meetings and shape recruitment strategy for early careers hiring
Source and attract early talent through university partnerships, campus programs (with a strong focus on Canadian and/or US institutions), job boards, talent platforms, and internal pipelines
Screen and assess candidates to build strong, diverse shortlists
Coordinate high-volume interview processes and deliver an excellent candidate experience
Ensure compliance with Canada and US job posting requirements, including pay transparency and sponsorship language
Partner with Talent Acquisition Operations and HR on offers, onboarding, and hiring documentation
Track and report on key recruiting metrics such as time-to-fill, conversion rates, and pipeline health
Contribute to the continuous improvement of early careers hiring programs and processes

3–6 years of recruiting experience, in-house or at an agency
Experience hiring for intern, co-op, or early careers roles
Ability to manage multiple high-volume requisitions simultaneously
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills
Experience working across Canadian and/or US markets
Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (e.g., SuccessFactors, Eightfold, SmartRecruiter)
Strong organizational and project management skills
Experience with diversity hiring or early talent pipeline development

Short-Term Variable Compensation Plan : Your pay also includes the opportunity for an annual bonus. Actual bonus payouts are based on performance of the business against the unit’s objectives, individual performance, and the individual bonus target. Certain eligibility and pro-ration rules apply.
Your Health
Ericsson offers excellent health benefits including the choice of 3 medical and dental plan options that allow an employee to select the level of coverage that suits their needs. Core level coverage is paid for fully by Ericsson.
Your Financial Security
We invest in both your short and long-term financial wellbeing. Ericsson’s Group Retirement & Savings Program offers an automatic 2% company contribution into the Pension Plan. Ericsson also offers a 50% match of employee’s contribution into the Registered Retirement Savings Plan, up to 8% of the employee’s contribution (maximum of 4% match).

We're looking for a passionate and driven Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our People team in Spain! This is a fully remote role, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere in the country. Please note that candidates must currently reside in Spain.
Join us at an exciting stage of growth at Wellhub, where you'll play a key role in shaping our European expansion. As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will partner closely with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to attract, engage, and hire top talent across the region.
In this role, you'll translate business needs into effective hiring strategies, helping to build high-performing teams that drive success in both established and new markets. You'll take ownership of end-to-end recruitment processes, ensuring an outstanding candidate experience while maintaining speed and quality.
Beyond day-to-day hiring, you'll contribute to improving recruiting practices through data-driven insights, helping us scale efficiently as we continue to grow. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys a mix of hands-on recruiting and strategic impact, and who is excited to help shape the future of our teams across Europe.

Manage the full-cycle recruitment process for non-technical roles up to G7 level, ensuring high-quality hires and alignment with business needs.
Partner closely with Hiring Managers and People Business Partners to define hiring strategies, evaluation criteria, and ensure a seamless calibration through kickoff meetings.
Develop and implement innovative sourcing strategies to build diverse talent pipelines and improve overall hiring effectiveness.
Drive a positive candidate experience by maintaining transparent communication, providing timely feedback, and acting as a professional brand ambassador for Wellhub.
Analyze recruitment metrics and data to identify bottlenecks, optimize processes, and formally propose improvements to increase the TA function's efficiency.
Ensure compliance with global labor laws, internal SLAs, and data accuracy (cost centers, candidate stages, and budget alignment) within our ATS (Greenhouse).
Promote diversity, equity, and belonging by proactively sourcing from underrepresented groups and mitigating biases throughout the selection process.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (People Ops, OD&B) to ensure smooth onboarding and contribute to employer branding initiatives.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

Degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Psychology, or a related field.
Proven experience in full-cycle recruitment, with a focus on high-demand environments.
Strong analytical skills to track, interpret, and report recruitment metrics.
Demonstrated ability to match financial budgets with candidate expectations regarding salary and benefits.
Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), preferably Greenhouse, to manage candidate pipelines.
Solid knowledge of sourcing strategies and tools to attract diverse talent.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
Proven track record of ensuring a high-quality candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
Fluency in English and German is required . Additional proficiency in either French or Spanish is preferred.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Recruiter (Global) to drive hiring across Engineering, Product, Data, AI, Infrastructure, and other technical functions globally.
This role combines hands-on recruitment execution with leadership responsibilities. You will be responsible for attracting top technical talent, partnering with senior stakeholders on hiring strategy, and helping build a high-performing Talent Acquisition function as the company continues to scale globally.
You will play a critical role in shaping BJAK’s technical workforce while mentoring junior recruiters and establishing best-in-class recruiting practices across the organization.

Technical Recruitment Leadership
Own the end-to-end recruitment process for technical positions across Engineering, Product, Data, AI, Machine Learning, Infrastructure, DevOps, Cybersecurity, QA, and related functions.
Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring requirements, interview strategies, talent profiles, and workforce planning priorities.
Act as a trusted talent advisor by providing market intelligence, talent mapping, compensation insights, and hiring recommendations.
Drive recruitment outcomes for complex, senior, niche, and business-critical technical positions globally.
Develop and execute innovative sourcing strategies to identify and engage top passive talent across competitive international markets.
Talent Pipeline & Market Intelligence
Build and maintain strong technical talent pipelines to support both immediate and future hiring needs.
Conduct talent mapping exercises across target companies, industries, and markets.
Stay current on technical hiring trends, market conditions, compensation benchmarks, and talent availability across key regions.
Team Development & Process Excellence
Mentor and support junior recruiters, helping improve sourcing capability, candidate assessment quality, and stakeholder management effectiveness.
Establish and continuously improve recruitment processes, sourcing methodologies, interview calibration standards, and hiring best practices.
Review recruitment performance, pipeline quality, and hiring outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.
Contribute to the growth and development of the global Talent Acquisition team as the organization scales.
Recruitment Operations & Reporting
Maintain accurate ATS data, candidate records, and recruitment reporting.
Track key recruitment metrics including pipeline health, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and hiring quality.
Ensure a positive, professional, and consistent candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
Support compliance with local hiring regulations and recruitment best practices across multiple regions.
The Right Fit Has
5-8 years of full-cycle recruitment experience, with significant exposure to technical hiring.
Proven track record recruiting for Software Engineering, Product Management, Data Science, AI/ML, Infrastructure, DevOps, Cybersecurity, or related technical functions.
Demonstrated success hiring senior and difficult-to-fill technical positions in competitive talent markets.
Strong sourcing expertise using LinkedIn Recruiter, talent mapping, networking, referrals, and other advanced sourcing techniques.
Experience managing multiple high-priority requisitions simultaneously while maintaining quality and speed.
Strong understanding of technical talent markets, technical role requirements, and engineering organizational structures.
Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing hiring decisions through data, insights, and market expertise.
Experience mentoring, coaching, or guiding junior recruiters is highly preferred.
Familiarity with global hiring practices, compensation structures, and recruitment across multiple countries.
Strong proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment analytics.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills.
Experience in high-growth technology companies, startups, internet businesses, or fast-scaling organizations is strongly preferred.
What Success Looks Like
Consistently delivers high-quality technical hires across multiple functions and regions.
Builds strong, sustainable talent pipelines for critical technical roles.
Serves as a trusted hiring partner to technical leaders and executives.
Improves recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and candidate experience.
Successfully develops junior recruiters and contributes to building a scalable Talent Acquisition function.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, ambitious hiring goals, and a high degree of ownership.

Above-market remuneration.
Fast-track career growth and leadership opportunities.
High ownership, autonomy, and direct impact on business growth.
Opportunity to build world-class technical teams globally.
Exposure to complex international hiring across multiple markets.
Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles.
Meaningful work that directly contributes to the future of technology and AI-enabled products.

Senior Tech Talent Acquisition Partner

At SumUp, we build simple, affordable financial tools that empower over 4 million small businesses worldwide to get paid, manage their money, and thrive. We are a global team of 3,000+ people across 20+ offices and 90+ nationalities, all dedicated to supporting merchants with excellent products.

As a Talent Acquisition team, we don't just fill seats. We care deeply about hiring excellence and finding people who truly elevate our teams. For us, recruitment is a team sport - we win together, constantly looking at how we can improve and bounce ideas off each other, and always step in to help whenever someone gets stuck or hits a wall.

Our Consumer Tribe - building the SumUp Pay App - is scaling fast and we’re looking for a Senior Tech TA Partner to help the team navigate London’s hyper-competitive market, where top engineers are in high demand.Your superpower will be understanding how to position SumUp's massive scale and impact to passive talent.

Operating as a true talent advisor, you will own hiring across Engineering, Product, Data, and Design (EP&D) for the Consumer portfolio, scaling the technical teams responsible for turning SumUp into a leading financial services platform.

Take a look at our London office

· Lead the full-cycle hiring journey for complex roles across Engineering, Product, Design, and Data for the Consumer tribe, maintaining a consistently high talent bar as we scale.

· Build trusted, embedded relationships with Consumer leadership. You’ll serve as a proactive advisor rather than a reactive coordinator - running regular hiring cadences, maintaining pipeline visibility, and providing market-led recommendations on role prioritization.

· Excel at identifying, engaging, and closing high-caliber passive tech talent in the London market, knowing how to articulate our technical challenges and unique value proposition effectively.

· Track and analyze funnel health metrics across your portfolio to surface blockers, challenge hiring assumptions, optimize sourcing efforts, and provide stakeholders with clear, honest pipeline updates.

· Create an inclusive hiring process that guarantees an exceptional experience for candidates and hiring teams alike, ensuring we stand out in a crowded market.

You'll be great for this role if…

· You have a proven track record of managing full-cycle talent acquisition for complex Engineering, Product, Data, and Design roles within fast-moving tech or fintech environments.

· You possess a deep understanding of the London and broader UK tech landscape, with a knack for mapping talent pools and knowing what it takes to attract and win over high-demand, engineering talent.

· You operate as a trusted business partner rather than just executing briefs - confidently managing multi-stakeholder portfolios, advising hiring managers on market realities, and expertly guiding interview calibration and debriefs.

· You have a data-first mindset, using funnel analytics and recruiting metrics to identify what’s working, track pipeline efficiency, and clearly influence stakeholder decisions.

· You have a genuine care for candidate experience, bringing empathy and transparency to every stage of the hiring journey.

Please note: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. You must have the right to work in the UK to be considered.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior.

Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time. About the Role You will lead hiring across software engineering functions including backend, mobile, desktop, infrastructure, and product engineering.

You will partner closely with founding teams, leadership and engineering leaders to identify and attract high-caliber talent globally. Lead end-to-end hiring for applications engineering roles globally
Source and engage high-quality software engineering talent across multiple markets
Partner closely with hiring managers and founders on hiring strategy and talent calibration
Assess candidate quality through career progression, technical depth, and execution signals

Proven experience recruiting software engineering talent in technology companies
Strong sourcing and talent mapping capability across global markets
Good understanding of engineering roles, technical stacks, and organizational structures

Strong communication, stakeholder management, and candidate engagement ability
Comfortable operating in fast-moving and ambiguous environments

As a Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner at vCluster Labs, you aren't just filling open requisitions, you are the architect of our first hiring presence Internationally. In this role, you will own recruiting across a broad mix of functions, from go to market to technical roles, partnering directly with leaders across the business rather than specializing in a single discipline. You will have the unique opportunity to shape how vCluster Labs hires Internationally.

s.h: As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, your role will include
s.t:
Full Cycle Generalist Recruiting: Own the end to end hiring process across Engineering, Product, Go to Market, and corporate roles globally. You will guide candidates from the initial talent screen through offer, adapting your approach to the function and level you are hiring for.
European Market Leadership: Serve as our first EMEA based recruiter and the local face of vCluster Labs for candidates across Europe. You will build the hiring practices, market knowledge, and candidate networks that support our growth in the region, while staying closely aligned with the US based People Ops team.
Strategic Sourcing: Proactively source and engage passive talent across technical communities as well as sales, marketing, and operations networks. You will build high quality pipelines so we are not relying solely on inbound applicants for priority roles.
Data Driven Execution: Champion our structured interview process across every function you support. You will ensure scorecards are used consistently to reduce bias and maintain strict data integrity within our ATS, Ashby, to inform hiring decisions.
Candidate Experience: Drive an exceptional experience through transparent, timely communication. You will treat every candidate, technical or go to market, with the same customer centric speed, making sure decisions happen in days, not months.
Partnership: Collaborate with hiring managers across departments to define role requirements and ideal candidate profiles. You will act as a consultant on market trends, compensation benchmarks, and closing strategy, not just an order taker.

s.h: This role could be a fit for you if you bring
s.t:
Experience: You have 5+ years of full cycle recruiting experience within a high growth tech startup, spanning multiple functions rather than a single specialty.
Generalist Range: You move comfortably between hiring for technical roles and go to market roles, and you can quickly get conversant in the language and priorities of each.
Location and Reach: You are based in Germany and ready to be vCluster Labs' first hire on the ground in Europe, working across European and US time zones as needed.
A Builder Mindset: You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoy refining processes to make them more efficient, especially as you stand up new practices for our European hiring.
A Data Centric Approach: You value results over tasks. You use data and analytics to track pipeline health across functions and inform decision making.
High EQ and Active Listening: You are an effective communicator who genuinely listens to understand the perspectives of candidates and hiring managers alike, across very different types of roles.

HR Generalist Background: Experience beyond recruiting, such as HR operations, employee relations, or onboarding, that gives you a broader view of the employee lifecycle.
ATS Proficiency: Experience with Ashby.
Domain Expertise: Experience recruiting for open source technology, developer tools, or companies working on Kubernetes tenant isolation.
Global Reach: A background hiring for distributed, remote first teams spanning multiple countries.
About vCluster Labs
We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture.
We are the leading platform for operating GPU infrastructure, enabling AI Cloud providers to deliver a hyperscaler-like experience to their customers and AI factories that need to build that same experience for their internal teams.

Our platform delivers the full operational stack operators need to run their GPU data centers — managed Kubernetes, fast isolated tenant provisioning, and automated node provisioning and lifecycle management — enabling them to accelerate time to value, reduce operational burden, and maximize the ROI of every GPU.
We're the company behind vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (10k+ GitHub stars, 40M+ virtual clusters created since 2021). Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI — a Kubernetes-native framework purpose-built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Competitive Salary : We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.
Platinum-Level Insurance : Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).
Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.
Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.
Culture & Values

s.h: At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for
s.t:
Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.
Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.
Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.
Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Company Description
Wüest Partner is an innovative and independent software and service company in the real estate industry. Since 1985, we have been creating sound decision-making foundations by combining real estate expertise, data, and digital solutions. As an industry leader, we shape the future of the real estate sector together with our clients - offering comprehensive services in valuation, consulting, data, analytics, AI, software, sustainability, and education.
The Wüest Partner Group employs around 500 people at 15 locations across Europe, with its headquarters in Switzerland. The group includes the subsidiaries Durable, Datahouse, Qualicasa, and Signa-Terre.
Job Description
Your Team & Mission
Recruiting is much more to us than just filling open positions - it is a crucial success factor for our growth. As part of our Human Resources Department, you will become a member of our Talent Acquisition & Development team and be responsible for operational recruiting in Switzerland and our international locations. You will work closely with our managers, HR business partners, and HR services, actively shaping recruitment success.
Together, we create a positive employee experience - from attracting new talent to developing our employees. With your experience, entrepreneurial thinking, and advisory skills, you ensure that we attract the right talent even in a dynamic environment.
Due to an upcoming maternity leave in our team, we are now looking for reinforcement and look forward to an experienced individual who will help us further develop Talent Acquisition and contribute to the future expansion of our department.
Your Tasks
* You are responsible for the entire recruiting process (end-to-end) for positions in Switzerland as well as at our international locations.
* You advise and coach hiring managers as a competent sparring partner and support them in making well-founded recruitment decisions, ensuring a smooth recruiting process.
* You develop targeted search strategies together with the specialist departments and implement them independently.
* You actively identify and approach suitable talents via various channels (active sourcing).
* You ensure an excellent candidate experience and professionally accompany candidates throughout the entire application process.
* You collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders and manage to advise and convince in a solution-oriented manner even in challenging situations.
* You analyse recruiting metrics, identify optimisation potentials, and contribute ideas for the continuous development of our recruiting processes and employer branding activities.

Your Profile
* At least five years of experience in in-house talent acquisition as well as experience recruiting for Switzerland and ideally for international locations.
* Completed studies (FH/university) or comparable education and training with a focus on human resources, business administration, or psychology.
* Active sourcing is second nature to you, and you use modern recruiting methods purposefully.
* You bring strong advisory skills and manage to professionally coach or challenge hiring managers and navigate confidently in a diverse stakeholder environment.
* You work independently, prioritise confidently, and take responsibility for your topics.
* You think entrepreneurially, recognise opportunities, and implement pragmatic solutions.
* Very good German and English skills, both written and spoken.
Additional Information

* Attractive employment conditions with a variable compensation component
* Flexible Work Smart concept with home office option
* Refreshing, professional, and collegial corporate culture with great events (company celebrations, croissant breaks, etc.)
* High team spirit, flat hierarchies, and varied tasks
* Beautiful workplace in the centre of Zurich with modern infrastructure
* Generous training budget including time for it as well as other attractive fringe benefits
Contact
If you have any questions, Federica Arcella, Lead Talent Acquisition Coordinator & Development, will be happy to assist you at talentacquisition@wuestpartner.com.
For recruitment agencies: Only direct applications will be considered.
For data protection reasons, applications can only be accepted online.

Veiller à la mise en place d'un système de contrôle interne adapté aux besoins de l'IPI et d'un système de gestion des risques et de la conformité

Participer à deux réunions ordinaires du Conseil de l'Institut par an
Excellentes connaissances en gestion stratégique des ressources humaines et faculté d'adapter la stratégie RH à la réalité de l'IPI et aux objectifs de l'entreprise

Expérience dans l'élaboration et l'évaluation de stratégies RH de même que dans les domaines de la gestion des talents, de la planification de la relève et du développement du leadership

Job Description
We build the operating system for renewables: more than 10 GW across 8,000+ plants run on the Amperecloud Platform. Growing that requires energy expertise, and it requires exceptional people. Finding them, developing them and keeping them is what this role exists for.
As
Talent Partner (m/f/d) you work directly with our founders. You own everything talent: who we hire, how we assess, how people grow, and the culture all of it runs on.
Lead: Frederik (CEO) & Florian Strunck (COO)
Contract type: Full-time, permanent
Start : October/November
Location: Berlin

The focus is singular: talent density and the culture that sustains it. You make sure the few people we hire are exceptional, that our strong people stay and grow, and that our values remain a working standard rather than a poster.
Within that focus, you are the third voice beside the founders on people decisions: who we hire, who we promote, who we bet on, when we part ways. You read people precisely, see early where they are heading, and say it out loud in the room where it counts. No process replaces that; ours is built to support it.
The same logic extends beyond the founders: to our decision-makers you are an advisor, not an order-taker. You read the talent market and tell them what their plans will cost, you sharpen how we present ourselves to candidates, and you build pipelines for the roles we will need before we need them.
You will not start from zero. Over the past year we built our People Guild: values translated into observable behaviors, a leveling framework with Berlin salary bands, structured interviews with an independent bar raiser who holds a veto, a lean feedback cycle. You inherit the engine mid-build, documented, with deadlines and founder sponsorship. You finish it, run it, and make it yours.

Hiring: Full-cycle recruiting for few, senior, often technical roles. Outbound-first: you map markets and build pipelines from scratch rather than waiting for applications. You run the culture screen as the first interview of every process and protect the hiring bar, founders included.
Culture: Our ADEPT values as a working rubric. Every interview, feedback cycle and promotion scores against it, and you keep it sharp.
Development and retention: Leveling, salary bands, a semi-annual feedback cycle, promotion rounds, VSOP administration, retention bets on key people.
Tooling and automation: Our ATS contract ends next year; you pick and roll out its successor. You build automations across our ATS, Notion and Humaans so manual work keeps shrinking and your time keeps moving toward talent and culture.

People decisions at a 40-person company are company decisions, and you make them with the founders
VSOP participation like everyone here: if the Operating System for Renewables becomes what we are building, that stake is meaningful
Salary band shared in the first conversation, not after four rounds

s.h: Development: educational leave, a steep curve by design
s.t:
Team & culture: regular offsites
Mobility & health: JobRad, up to 100% Deutschlandticket subsidy, pension plan, Wellpass/Urban Sports, childcare subsidies

Full-cycle recruiting experience from high-paced environments: a high-growth startup or scaleup, the talent team of a VC or PE firm, or a top search firm, including senior and engineering searches you sourced and closed yourself. Years matter less than evidence: show us numbers (pass-through rates, offer-accept rate, quality of hire after 12 months).
AI as your default way of working, not a tool you tried. You use LLMs daily and can walk us through real workflows you built: sourcing and market mapping, structured screening support, scorecard synthesis, drafting at scale. In the interview, you will show us one, live.
Automation literacy: You have connected tools via APIs or no-code (Apps Script, Zapier/Make/n8n or similar) to kill manual work. You read API docs without flinching. You do not need to be an engineer; you need to think like one about repetitive tasks.
Evidence-based assessment: You run structured interviews and can defend a hire or no-hire with observations, not impressions. A track record of calls that aged well: hires that outperformed, hard cases you named early.
German employment law working knowledge: contracts, terminations, fixed terms, works-council-free environments. Enough to know when you need a lawyer, and when you do not.
Data fluency: strong Sheets/Excel, comfortable owning funnel and retention metrics end to end; SQL basics a plus.
German (C1+) and English fluent. Our contracts are German, our company language is English.
First-principles thinker who writes things down. Default output
The process
Exactly the one you will later run: culture screen, skill assessment with a live case (bring your AI workflows), founder final.
We evaluate based on ability and potential, independent of age, gender identity, origin, sexual orientation, disability, or religion.

The Department of Management, Technology, and Economics (D-MTEC) is looking for an Admissions & Recruitment Manager (80-100%) to join the MAS MTEC team for an 8-month maternity cover.

The Master of Advanced Studies ETH in Management, Technology, and Economics is a long-established continuing education programme at ETH Zurich, with a strong history of management education for experienced professionals.

Since 1980, more than 2,000 graduates have benefited from the advantages of ETH Zurich and the Department of Management, Technology, and Economics to take on management and leadership roles in their professional careers.
Projekthintergrund
This position is a maternity leave cover, with a defined project scope focused on ensuring continuity across admissions and recruitment activities during this period. As the Admissions & Recruitment Manager, you will support the day-to-day delivery of admissions and recruitment activities for our MAS ETH MTEC.

You will work closely with prospective candidates throughout their journey, from initial enquiry and profile assessment through application, admission and enrolment. Your role will be to ensure that established admissions and recruitment processes continue to run smoothly and that candidates receive a consistent, high-quality experience.
Aufgaben-/Stellenbeschreibung

Engaging directly with prospective candidates through consultations, interviews and follow-up conversations.
Supporting candidates throughout the admissions journey and ensuring a high-quality candidate experience.
Managing the candidate pipeline and CRM, ensuring leads and applications are followed up consistently and candidate information is kept up to date.
Coordinating the day-to-day admissions process, including applications, interviews, admissions documentation and candidate communication.
Organisation and delivery of recruitment events and activities, including information sessions, webinars and other candidate-facing events.
Coordinating with external recruitment and lead-generation partners and ensuring incoming leads are processed and followed up.
Working closely with the Programme Manager, Marketing and Communications Manager and the wider programme team to deliver planned recruitment activities.
Monitoring the recruitment pipeline and key conversion metrics and preparing regular reports.
Supporting general recruitment and admissions administration as required.
Ihr Profil

2–4 years of professional experience in admissions, recruitment, sales or another customer-facing role.
Strong communication skills in English and a high level of customer orientation.
Confidence engaging with prospective candidates from diverse professional and international backgrounds.
Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple candidates and activities simultaneously.
Comfortable working collaboratively with different internal and external stakeholders.
Experience working with CRM systems is an advantage.
Wir bieten
A collaborative and supportive team environment
A structured handover and clear responsibilities during the maternity cover period
Hands-on experience in admissions and recruitment within a leading university environment
Flexible working arrangements, including the possibility to work from home
